{{short description|German mathematician}}
'''Martin Schottenloher''' is a German [[mathematician]].

== Life ==

He was born on July 25, 1944, in Lindau, Germany.

He specializes in [[algorithm]]s, [[artificial intelligence]] and complex analysis.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Martin_Schottenloher|title=Martin Schottenloher – Expertise: Algorithms, Artificial Intelligence, Analysis|via= ResearchGate |publisher=Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München, Munich}}</ref>

== Career ==

He completed his Dr. rer. nat. degree at [[LMU Munich]] in 1972. His doctoral supervisors were Walter Roelcke and [[Karl Stein (mathematician)|Karl Stein]].<ref name="nodak.edu">{{cite web|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=29354|title=Martin Schottenloher |publisher=The Mathematics Genealogy Project}}</ref> He obtained his habilitation in 1975 also from LMU Munich.<ref name="lmu">{{cite web|url=http://www.mathematik.uni-muenchen.de/festschrift/node112.html#SECTION006220000000000000000|title=Martin Schottenloher|publisher=Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München}}</ref>

At LMU Munich, he supervised the doctoral [[dissertation]]s of more than a dozen students.<ref name="nodak.edu"/>

Some of his books and papers are:<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.goodreads.com/author/show/1733653.Martin_Schottenloher|title=Martin Schottenloher|via=Goodreads}}</ref>

* {{cite book | last=Sachsenmeier | first=Peter | last2=Schottenloher | first2=Martin | title=Challenges Between Competition and Collaboration : the Future of the European Manufacturing Industry | publisher=Springer Berlin Heidelberg | publication-place=Berlin, Heidelberg | date=2003 | isbn=978-3-662-05195-5 | oclc=851392645}}
* {{cite book | last=Husemöller | first=Dale | title=Basic bundle theory and K-cohomology invariants | publisher=Springer | publication-place=Berlin | date=2008 | isbn=978-3-540-74956-1 | oclc=233973513}}
* {{cite book | last=Schottenloher | first=Martin | title=Geometrie und Symmetrie in der Physik | publisher=Vieweg+Teubner Verlag | publication-place=Wiesbaden | year=1995 | isbn=978-3-528-06565-2 | doi=10.1007/978-3-322-89928-6}}
